outline: We will introduce topics in digital communication techniques, including Bandpass signals and systems, sampling theory, power spectral density, and digital modulation techniques (pulse amplitude modulation, (PAM), phase shift keying (PSK), frequency shift keying (FSK), quadrture-amplitude modulation (QAM), minimum shift keying (MSK), orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM)).
schedule:
Bandpass signals and systems, sampling theory, power spectral density (5 weeks)
Random processes, power spectral density (3 weeks)
Baseband pulse transmission  (2 weeks)
Passband digital transmission (PSK, QAM, FSK, MSK,OFDM) (2 months)
